[Verse 1]
[D/F#]Late afternoon, a-
[Cadd9]nother day is nearly done
[G]
[D/F#]A darker grey is
[Cadd9]breaking through a lighter one
[G]
[D/F#]A thousand sharpened
[Cadd9]elbows in the underground
[G]
[D/F#]That hollow, hurried
[Cadd9]sound Of
[Em]feet on [D/F#]polished floor
[Cadd9]And

[Chorus]
[Em]in the [D/F#]dollar
[Cadd9]store The
[Em]clerk is [D/F#]closing
[A]up And
counting loonies, trying not to
[D9/C]say
I hate
[G]Winnipeg

[Verse 2]
[D/F#]The driver checks the
[Cadd9]mirror, seven minutes late
[G]
[D/F#]The crowded riders'
[Cadd9]restlessness enunciates
[G]
[D/F#]The Guess Who suck, the
[Cadd9]Jets were lousy anyway
[G]
[D/F#]The same route eve-
[Cadd9]ry day And
[Em]in the [D/F#]turning lane
[Cadd9]

[Chorus]
[Em]Someone's [D/F#]stalled again
[Cadd9]He's
[Em]talking to [D/F#]himself
[A]And
hears the price of gas repeat his
[D9/C]phrase
I hate
[G]Winnipeg

[Interlude]
[D/F#]
[Cadd9]
[G]
[D/F#]
[Cadd9]
[G]
[D/F#]
[Cadd9]And

[Chorus]
[Em]up above [D/F#]us all,
[Cadd9]
[Em]leaning [D/F#]into sky
[Cadd9]A
[Em]golden [D/F#]business boy
[Cadd9]will
[Em]watch the north [D/F#]end
[Cadd9]die And
[Em]sing "I love [D/F#]this town"
[A]Then
let his arcing wrecking ball pro-
[Cadd9]claim

[Outro]
[Cadd9]I
[D/F#]hate
[G]Winnipeg
title: One Great City
